description:
Three existing Jenkins freestyle jobs need to be chained together to form a continuous integration pipeline. Configure the jobs so that:

1. 'inventory-build' automatically triggers 'inventory-test' when it completes successfully
2. 'inventory-test' automatically triggers 'inventory-deploy' when it completes successfully

The three jobs already exist on the Jenkins dashboard: inventory-build, inventory-test, and inventory-deploy. They currently run independently with no triggers between them.

You can use EITHER approach:
- Add 'Build other projects' post-build actions on the upstream jobs, OR
- Add 'Build after other projects are built' triggers on the downstream jobs

Ensure triggers fire only on successful builds (not on failure or unstable).
